evidence_status: Post-hoc arithmetic reanalysis of existing exploratory results; not calibration or independent confirmation.

method.score: native returned confidence, not maximum option probability
method.missing_or_invalid_confidence: Rejected at every threshold; retained in total counts.
method.exact_boundary_definition: Original decimal confidence equals threshold, regardless of comparison mode.
method.correctness: Raw selected choice decoded using original request options and compared to unchanged cases.json reference.
method.unit: Decision under one option mapping; 108 cases and 12 parent families, not 216 independent cases.
method.threshold_selection: Post-hoc audit thresholds 0.9, 0.95, 0.99; no fitted/calibrated acceptance rule.
method.source_coverage: Main Jev grid only; six smoke calls excluded via original plan phase.

external_reference_zip.treatment: Read-only reference; no code imported, applied, or copied as the implementation.
external_reference_zip.threshold_scope: 0.9 and 0.99 were in the zip; 0.95 is an explicitly added audit threshold, not a claimed zip output.

provenance.verification_policy: Without --reference-zip, recompute local science and implementation hashes while retaining external metadata as prior provenance only; with the ZIP, also recheck its bytes and recorded members.

limits: No new model inference or human label review.
Synthetic unit-test fixtures are not research observations.
Threshold counts do not establish calibrated confidence, deployment safety, or a universal zero-error region.
Original source labels are preserved, not independently revalidated by this arithmetic check.
